title: SNACK JSON output envelope
description: The document every `--json` invocation writes to stdout. A candidate public contract: from 1.0 the named fields do not change meaning or disappear without a major release. `data` is deliberately unconstrained here -- per-command payloads freeze at the 0.9 feature freeze, not before, and constraining them now would freeze shapes that are still moving.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope contract. Additive fields do not bump it; a removal or a changed meaning does.

command.description: The command that produced the document, as the user would type it after `snack`.

generated_at.description: When the document was produced, from the injected clock.

status.description: Whether the command answered fully, answered with something degraded, or failed.

data.description: The command's payload, or null when there is none to give.

diagnostics.description: Always present, empty when there is nothing to report, so a consumer never has to distinguish absent from empty.
